findings.title: Controller join has no visible focus before Confirm activates Return
findings.trigger: Fresh About page with BODY focus; neutral standard pad, South to join, release, then a fresh South press.
findings.actual: Join and release leave BODY active without a controller focus mark. The next Confirm both focuses Return and activates it, leaving the page before a visible selection existed.
findings.expected: Joining establishes a visible default focus without activation, and meaningful existing focus is preserved.
findings.recommendation: On the fresh joined status, engage the existing navigation owner in the foreground. Add actual About-host tests asserting focused Return immediately after join/release, no held-Confirm activation, and preservation of meaningful prior focus.
findings.evidenceScope: Finite modeled DOM/pad probe importing actual About/router/navigation modules; not physical-controller or browser qualification.
findings.disposition: Parent acknowledged and assigned correction to the source owner. The correction must be a successor commit; this review does not approve that unreviewed successor.
